intro: 12 個辦公室科技情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The company's first priority was to find an affordable phone system.
ex.zh: 公司的首要任務是找到一套負擔得起的電話系統。

ex.en: Obviously, the computer systems that are affordable for a Fortune 500 company will not be affordable for a small company.
ex.zh: 顯然,財星五百大企業負擔得起的電腦系統,小公司是負擔不起的。

note: be affordable for sb;afford 則用 can afford to V
afford 負擔得起;affordability 可負擔性

ex.en: The courier service did not come every day, only as needed.
ex.zh: 快遞服務並非每天都來,只在必要時才來。

ex.en: The service contract states that repairs will be made as needed.
ex.zh: 服務合約載明,維修將視需要進行。

note: 置於句尾,修飾整個動作的頻率

ex.en: We need a room with the capacity to hold two photocopiers and shelves for paper and other supplies.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個空間足以容納兩台影印機,以及放紙張和其他用品的架子。

ex.en: The memory requirements of this software application exceed the capacity of our computers.
ex.zh: 這個軟體應用程式的記憶體需求超出了我們電腦的容量。

note: the capacity to V 有能力做⋯;at full capacity 滿載
capacity 指容納量;ability 指能力

ex.en: This printer is so durable that, with a little care, it will last another five years.
ex.zh: 這台印表機非常耐用,只要稍加保養,還可以再用五年。

ex.en: The phone is very durable; I've dropped it several times and it still works well.
ex.zh: 這支手機很耐用,我摔過好幾次它還是運作良好。

note: durability 耐用度;durable goods 耐久財

ex.en: He appointed someone to be in charge of maintaining a supply of paper in the fax machine.
ex.zh: 他指派了一個人負責維持傳真機的紙張供應。

ex.en: Your computer should not be in charge of you, rather you should be in charge of your computer.
ex.zh: 不該讓電腦掌控你,而是你該掌控你的電腦。

note: be in charge of sth 負責某事;take charge 接手掌管
in charge of 是負責;in the charge of 是「由⋯照管」

words.zh: 主動的行動、進取心;倡議、積極性

ex.en: Employees are encouraged to take the initiative to discuss their technology needs with management.
ex.zh: 公司鼓勵員工主動與管理層討論他們的技術需求。

ex.en: Our technology initiative involves a new database that will help revolutionize our customer service.
ex.zh: 我們的技術計畫包含一個新資料庫,將徹底革新我們的客戶服務。

note: take the initiative 採取主動;on one's own initiative 自發地
initiate 發起、開始;initial 最初的

ex.en: The computer screen is making her physically sick.
ex.zh: 電腦螢幕讓她身體不適。

ex.en: Physically moving your screen from one place on the desk to another can help reduce same-position-strain syndrome.
ex.zh: 把螢幕在桌上實際移動位置,有助於減輕固定姿勢造成的勞損症候群。

note: 可指身體上,也可指「實體地」相對於數位
physical 身體的、實體的;physique 體格

ex.en: The department was extremely pleased with the service they received from the phone provider.
ex.zh: 該部門對電話供應商提供的服務非常滿意。

ex.en: We need to find a new provider of supplies for our photocopier.
ex.zh: 我們需要為影印機找一家新的耗材供應商。

note: service provider 服務供應商;ISP 網路服務供應商
provide 提供;provision 供給、條款

ex.en: The need for repairs to the photocopier recurs too often.
ex.zh: 影印機需要維修的情況太常發生了。

ex.en: The managers did not want that particular error to recur.
ex.zh: 主管們不希望那個特定的錯誤再次發生。

note: recurrence 再發生;recurrent 一再發生的

ex.en: The outlet store gave a 20 percent reduction in the price of the shelves and bookcases.
ex.zh: 暢貨中心把架子和書櫃的價格降了百分之二十。

ex.en: The reduction in office staff has made it necessary to automate more job functions.
ex.zh: 辦公室人力縮減,使得更多職務必須自動化。

note: a reduction in sth 在⋯方面的減少
reduce 減少;reduced 已調降的

ex.en: It's important to stay on top of supplies for the printers and reorder them before they run out.
ex.zh: 掌握印表機耗材的狀況並在用完前補訂,是很重要的。

ex.en: In this industry, you must stay on top of current developments.
ex.zh: 在這個產業,你必須隨時掌握最新的發展。

ex.en: Please stock the shelves with a large supply of ink and paper for the printers.
ex.zh: 請在架上備妥大量的印表機墨水和紙張。

ex.en: The office's stock of toner for the photocopier was quickly running out.
ex.zh: 辦公室的影印機碳粉庫存很快就要用完了。

note: in stock 有現貨;out of stock 缺貨
另有「股票」之意,stock market 股市
